 Students can check the MSBSHSE Class 10 and 12 subject-wise date sheet PDF on the official website, mahahsscboard, once the Maharashtra SSC HSC Time Table 2027 is released.
 MSBSHSE has announced the tentative dates for the SSC Class 10 and HSC Class 12 board examinations 2027. The HSC written examinations will be held from February 8 to March 16, 2027, and the SSC written examinations are scheduled from February 15 to March 11, 2027.

 Maharashtra Board Exams 2027 form filling last date
 The MSBSHSE has granted an extension for filling out MSBSHSE Class 10 and 12 exam application forms at the regular fee. The extension is available to the following categories of candidates:
 Regular students
 Repeaters
 Private students with enrollment certificates
 Students under the Class Improvement Scheme
 Students appearing for isolated subjects
 ITI students taking Transfer of Credit
 Schools and junior colleges must deposit exam fees by December 7 and verify student details.
 Maharashtra SSC HSC Time Table 2027: How to download?
 Follow the steps below to download the Maharashtra SSC and HSC 2027 subject-wise examination schedule.
 Visit the official website, mahahsscboard.in
 Check the latest notifications or the examination section
 Click on the Maharashtra SSC or HSC timetable 2027 link
 Open the date sheet PDF and check the subject-wise examination dates
 Download and save the PDF for future reference
 Students should verify the examination dates and timings from the official timetable. They should also visit the MSBSHSE website for further updates regarding the timetable and examination guidelines.
